title: The bottle man's horn and street criers
summary: Wiggs recalls the bottle man blowing blues on a tin carnival horn, and the blackberry women's voices, as his earliest musical influences.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

Well, the Bottle Man collected uh, uh, bottles uh, as the uh, title indicates. Uh, and he went around uh, uh, blowing on his horn. Well, these uh, uh, colored men that drove these uh, wagons would take the mouthpiece off and they, they'd humor that brass reed like a clarinet player humors his uh, uh, clarinet reed to get the various uh, uh, intonation, various pitches. Oh no, no, it wasn't one. They, they were all over town. Yeah. Yeah. And uh, the, uh, I remember these uh, blues as being the most beautiful sound that I could imagine.
